title: SAP Data Migration Analyst
description:
As a SAP Data Migration Analyst in Manchester, you will manage data migration work for an FMCG organisation, helping ensure information is ready for use across SAP systems. You will work within the Analytics department to keep data accurate, organised and available for business teams.

Client Details

We are a FMCG company with our head office in Manchester. We supply private label and contract-manufactured household, cleaning, and hygiene products across Europe and beyond.


We are currently working through a large scale SAP migration to S4 Hana.

Description

The successful SAP Data Migration Analyst will be responsible for but not limited to:


  • Plan and deliver SAP data migration activities to support business system needs.
  • Review source data and prepare it for migration into SAP.
  • Clean, map and validate data to improve accuracy before loading.
  • Work with Analytics colleagues to define data requirements and priorities.
  • Support data extraction, transformation and loading processes for SAP.
  • Check migrated data and resolve issues found during testing.
  • Maintain clear documentation for migration rules, data mappings and outcomes.
  • Provide updates on migration progress, risks and data quality issues.

Profile

The successful 'SAP Data Migration Analyst' should have:


  • Experience of SAP data migration activities including
  • BODS/SDS SQL, Data Migration and data quality management
  • Ability to review, clean and validate large data sets.
  • Experience of investigating data issues and supporting their resolution.
  • Confidence working with data requirements and migration documentation.
  • Ability to work closely with Analytics teams and business users.

Job Offer

This is a 12 month fixed term contract, to join us whilst we are migrating over to S4 Hana, We are easily commutable for anyone in the Manchester and surrounding areas and we offer a 50 50 hybrid working policy.


  • FTC SAP Data Migration Analyst position in Manchester.
  • Salary of £65,000 to £70,000, dependent on the level of experience.
  • Car allowance £6000
  • 25 days holiday
  • Thank You Days: Option of 3 days extra holiday per annum

If you're interested in this role, apply now.
